```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SHIKINE URCHIN MICROBIOME
# Preprocessing, QC, sample splitting and contaminant removal
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD PACKAGES
# ============================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(Biostrings)
library(phangorn)
library(DECIPHER)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(microDecon)


# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD DADA2 OUTPUTS
# ============================================================

seqtab.nochim <- readRDS(
  file = "Results/04_seqtab.nochim2.rds"
)

taxa <- readRDS(
  file = "02_Temp_Data/taxa_2.rds"
)

fitGTR <- readRDS(
  file = "02_Temp_Data/fitGTR5_2.rds"
)


# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD AND CLEAN METADATA
# ============================================================

Metadata <- read.csv(
  "Metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

Metadata <- as.data.frame(Metadata)

Metadata <- column_to_rownames(
  Metadata,
  var = "SampleID"
)

rownames(Metadata) <- sub(
  "_R1_001\\.fastq\\.gz$",
  "",
  rownames(Metadata)
)

stopifnot(
  anyDuplicated(rownames(Metadata)) == 0
)


# ============================================================
# 4. CHECK AND MATCH ASVs
# ============================================================

if (!is.matrix(taxa)) {
  taxa <- as.matrix(taxa)
}

stopifnot(
  all(colnames(seqtab.nochim) %in% rownames(taxa))
)


# ============================================================
# 5. MATCH SAMPLES
# ============================================================

common_samples <- intersect(
  rownames(seqtab.nochim),
  rownames(Metadata)
)

cat(
  "Samples in sequence table:",
  nrow(seqtab.nochim),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Samples in metadata:",
  nrow(Metadata),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Samples shared between both:",
  length(common_samples),
  "\n"
)

seqtab.nochim <- seqtab.nochim[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

Metadata <- Metadata[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(seqtab.nochim),
    rownames(Metadata)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 6. CREATE MASTER PHYLOSEQ OBJECT
# ============================================================

ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(
    seqtab.nochim,
    taxa_are_rows = FALSE
  ),
  sample_data(Metadata),
  tax_table(taxa),
  phy_tree(fitGTR$tree)
)

cat(
  "Initial phyloseq samples:",
  nsamples(ps),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Initial phyloseq ASVs:",
  ntaxa(ps),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Initial total reads:",
  sum(sample_sums(ps)),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 7. ADD ORIGINAL DNA SEQUENCES
# ============================================================

dna <- DNAStringSet(
  taxa_names(ps)
)

names(dna) <- taxa_names(ps)

ps <- merge_phyloseq(
  ps,
  dna
)

taxa_names(ps) <- paste0(
  "ASV",
  seq(ntaxa(ps))
)

rm(dna)


# ============================================================
# 8. UNIVERSAL TAXONOMIC QC
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("TAXONOMIC QC\n")
cat("========================================\n")

# ---- Remove ASVs without phylum assignment ----

cat(
  "ASVs before NA-phylum removal:",
  ntaxa(ps),
  "\n"
)

ps_qc <- subset_taxa(
  ps,
  !is.na(Phylum)
)

cat(
  "ASVs after NA-phylum removal:",
  ntaxa(ps_qc),
  "\n"
)


# ---- Remove chloroplast ASVs ----

n_chloroplast <- ntaxa(
  subset_taxa(
    ps_qc,
    Order == "Chloroplast"
  )
)

cat(
  "Chloroplast ASVs removed:",
  n_chloroplast,
  "\n"
)

ps_qc <- subset_taxa(
  ps_qc,
  is.na(Order) | Order != "Chloroplast"
)


# ---- Remove mitochondrial ASVs ----

n_mitochondrial <- ntaxa(
  subset_taxa(
    ps_qc,
    Family == "Mitochondria"
  )
)

cat(
  "Mitochondrial ASVs removed:",
  n_mitochondrial,
  "\n"
)

ps_qc <- subset_taxa(
  ps_qc,
  is.na(Family) | Family != "Mitochondria"
)


# ============================================================
# 9. REMOVE ZERO-COUNT SAMPLES AND ASVs
# ============================================================

ps_qc <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(ps_qc) > 0,
  ps_qc
)

ps_qc <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_qc) > 0,
  ps_qc
)

cat(
  "Final QC samples:",
  nsamples(ps_qc),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Final QC ASVs:",
  ntaxa(ps_qc),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Final QC reads:",
  sum(sample_sums(ps_qc)),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 10. CHECK SAMPLE TYPES
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("SAMPLE TYPES AFTER UNIVERSAL QC\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  table(
    sample_data(ps_qc)$SampleType
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 11. DEFINE SAMPLE GROUPS
# ============================================================

sample_names_qc <- sample_names(ps_qc)


# ---- Shikine gut ----

gut_samples <- grepl(
  "^Shikine_[CH][0-9]+_",
  sample_names_qc
) &
!sample_names_qc %in% c(
  "Shikine_C11_S11",
  "Shikine_C16_S16"
)


# ---- Shikine seawater ----

water_samples <- grepl(
  "^Shikine_H2O_",
  sample_names_qc
)


# ---- Extraction blanks ----

blank_samples <- grepl(
  "^Extraction_Blank[1-6]_",
  sample_names_qc
)


# ---- Bacterial standard ----

standard_samples <- grepl(
  "^Bacterial_Standard_",
  sample_names_qc
)


# ---- PBS filter control ----

filter_samples <- grepl(
  "^Filter_PBS_H2O_",
  sample_names_qc
)


# ---- Shikine field/water blank ----

field_blank_samples <- grepl(
  "^Shikine_Blank_H2O_",
  sample_names_qc
)


# ============================================================
# 12. CREATE SEPARATE SAMPLE OBJECTS
# ============================================================
#
# IMPORTANT:
# prune_taxa() is performed AFTER each sample subset.
#
# This prevents ASVs that occur only in other sample types
# (e.g. blanks, water, standards) from being carried into
# the gut object with zero abundance.
#
# Therefore ps_gut represents the actual ASVs detected in
# the 30 gut samples.
# ============================================================


# ---- Gut ----

ps_gut <- prune_samples(
  gut_samples,
  ps_qc
)

ps_gut <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_gut) > 0,
  ps_gut
)


# ---- Water ----

ps_water <- prune_samples(
  water_samples,
  ps_qc
)

ps_water <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_water) > 0,
  ps_water
)


# ---- Extraction blanks ----

ps_blanks <- prune_samples(
  blank_samples,
  ps_qc
)

ps_blanks <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_blanks) > 0,
  ps_blanks
)


# ---- Bacterial standard ----

ps_standard <- prune_samples(
  standard_samples,
  ps_qc
)

ps_standard <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_standard) > 0,
  ps_standard
)


# ---- PBS filter control ----

ps_filter <- prune_samples(
  filter_samples,
  ps_qc
)

ps_filter <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_filter) > 0,
  ps_filter
)


# ---- Field/water blank ----

ps_field_blank <- prune_samples(
  field_blank_samples,
  ps_qc
)

ps_field_blank <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_field_blank) > 0,
  ps_field_blank
)


# ============================================================
# 13. CHECK SAMPLE NUMBERS
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("SAMPLE GROUPS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat(
  "All QC'd samples:",
  nsamples(ps_qc),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Gut samples:",
  nsamples(ps_gut),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Water samples:",
  nsamples(ps_water),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Extraction blanks:",
  nsamples(ps_blanks),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Bacterial standards:",
  nsamples(ps_standard),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Filter controls:",
  nsamples(ps_filter),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Field/water blank:",
  nsamples(ps_field_blank),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 14. CHECK GUT DATASET
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("GUT DATASET BEFORE CONTAMINANT REMOVAL\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat(
  "Samples:",
  nsamples(ps_gut),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ASVs:",
  ntaxa(ps_gut),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Total reads:",
  sum(sample_sums(ps_gut)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Minimum reads/sample:",
  min(sample_sums(ps_gut)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Maximum reads/sample:",
  max(sample_sums(ps_gut)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Median reads/sample:",
  median(sample_sums(ps_gut)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Mean reads/sample:",
  mean(sample_sums(ps_gut)),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 15. NMDS OF QC'D SAMPLES
# ============================================================
#
# CLR transformation is used for ordination visualisation.
# A pseudocount of 1 is added to zero-count ASVs prior to
# CLR transformation.
#
# ============================================================
library(compositions)

ps_qc_nmds <- filter_taxa(
    ps_qc,
    function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 2,
    prune = TRUE
)

# CLR transformation with pseudocount
clr_transform <- function(x) {
  x <- x + 1
  clr(x)
}

# CLR-transformed data
ps_clr <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps_qc_nmds,
  clr_transform
)

# NMDS using Euclidean distance on CLR data
GP.ord.clr <- ordinate(
  ps_clr,
  method = "NMDS",
  distance = "euclidean"
)

# Stress
stress_val <- round(GP.ord.clr$stress, 3)
stress_label <- paste0("Stress = ", stress_val)

# Plot
clr_nMDS_qc <- plot_ordination(
  ps_clr,
  GP.ord.clr,
  type = "samples",
  color = "Treatment",
  label = "ID"
) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = stress_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 4
  )

clr_nMDS_qc

# ============================================================
# 16. PREPARE DATA FOR microDecon
# ============================================================

# Gut OTU table

gut_otu <- as(
  otu_table(ps_gut),
  "matrix"
)

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_gut)) {
  gut_otu <- t(gut_otu)
}


# Extraction blank OTU table

blank_otu <- as(
  otu_table(ps_blanks),
  "matrix"
)

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_blanks)) {
  blank_otu <- t(blank_otu)
}


# ============================================================
# 17. COMBINE GUT AND BLANK ASVs
# ============================================================
#
# microDecon requires a combined table containing ASVs found
# in either the gut samples or extraction blanks.
#
# ASVs absent from one dataset are assigned zero counts.
#
# ============================================================

# Get ASV IDs from each dataset
gut_asvs <- rownames(gut_otu)
blank_asvs <- rownames(blank_otu)

# Union of all ASVs
all_asvs <- union(
  gut_asvs,
  blank_asvs
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create expanded gut table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gut_otu_expanded <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_asvs),
  ncol = ncol(gut_otu),
  dimnames = list(
    all_asvs,
    colnames(gut_otu)
  )
)

gut_otu_expanded[
  gut_asvs,
  colnames(gut_otu)
] <- gut_otu


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create expanded blank table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

blank_otu_expanded <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_asvs),
  ncol = ncol(blank_otu),
  dimnames = list(
    all_asvs,
    colnames(blank_otu)
  )
)

blank_otu_expanded[
  blank_asvs,
  colnames(blank_otu)
] <- blank_otu


# Replace original objects
gut_otu <- gut_otu_expanded
blank_otu <- blank_otu_expanded

rm(
  gut_otu_expanded,
  blank_otu_expanded
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nASVs in gut:",
  length(gut_asvs),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ASVs in blanks:",
  length(blank_asvs),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Combined ASVs for microDecon:",
  length(all_asvs),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(gut_otu),
    all_asvs
  )
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(blank_otu),
    all_asvs
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 18. ORDER GUT SAMPLES BY CONDITION
# ============================================================

gut_metadata <- as.data.frame(
  sample_data(ps_gut)
)

reference_samples <- rownames(gut_metadata)[
  gut_metadata$Condition == "Reference"
]

elevated_samples <- rownames(gut_metadata)[
  gut_metadata$Condition == "Elevated CO2"
]

cat(
  "Reference samples:",
  length(reference_samples),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Elevated samples:",
  length(elevated_samples),
  "\n"
)

stopifnot(
  length(reference_samples) == 14
)

stopifnot(
  length(elevated_samples) == 16
)

gut_otu <- gut_otu[
  ,
  c(
    reference_samples,
    elevated_samples
  ),
  drop = FALSE
]


# ============================================================
# 19. EXTRACT TAXONOMY
# ============================================================

tax_df <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(ps_gut)
)

tax_df$ASV <- rownames(tax_df)

tax_columns <- intersect(
  c(
    "Kingdom",
    "Phylum",
    "Class",
    "Order",
    "Family",
    "Genus",
    "Species"
  ),
  colnames(tax_df)
)

tax_string <- apply(
  tax_df[, tax_columns, drop = FALSE],
  1,
  function(x) {
    
    x <- x[
      !is.na(x) &
      x != ""
    ]
    
    paste(
      x,
      collapse = "; "
    )
  }
)

names(tax_string) <- tax_df$ASV


# ============================================================
# 20. CREATE microDecon INPUT TABLE
# ============================================================

microdecon_table <- data.frame(
  OTU_ID = all_asvs,
  blank_otu[
    all_asvs,
    sample_names(ps_blanks),
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  gut_otu[
    all_asvs,
    c(
      reference_samples,
      elevated_samples
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ],
  Taxa = tax_string[all_asvs],
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nmicroDecon input dimensions:",
  nrow(microdecon_table),
  "ASVs x",
  ncol(microdecon_table),
  "columns\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 21. RUN microDecon
# ============================================================

decon_result <- decon(
  data = microdecon_table,
  numb.blanks = 6,
  numb.ind = c(14, 16),
  taxa = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# 22. INSPECT microDecon OUTPUT
# ============================================================

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("microDecon RESULTS\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat(
  "Rows before decontamination:",
  nrow(microdecon_table),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Rows after decontamination:",
  nrow(decon_result$decon.table),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nOTUs completely removed:\n")

print(
  decon_result$OTUs.removed
)


# ============================================================
# 23. READS REMOVED BY microDecon
# ============================================================

reads_removed <- decon_result$reads.removed

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("READS REMOVED BY microDecon\n")
cat("========================================\n")

print(
  head(reads_removed)
)

total_reads_removed <- sum(
  as.numeric(
    as.matrix(
      reads_removed[
        ,
        -1,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    )
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "\nTotal reads removed:",
  format(
    total_reads_removed,
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 24. EXTRACT DECONTAMINATED GUT OTU TABLE
# ============================================================

decon_table <- decon_result$decon.table

decon_sample_columns <- c(
  reference_samples,
  elevated_samples
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    decon_sample_columns %in%
      colnames(decon_table)
  )
)

gut_clean_otu <- as.matrix(
  decon_table[
    ,
    decon_sample_columns,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

rownames(gut_clean_otu) <- decon_table$OTU_ID

gut_clean_otu <- round(
  gut_clean_otu
)

gut_clean_otu[gut_clean_otu < 0] <- 0


# ============================================================
# 25. REBUILD PHYLOSEQ OBJECT
# ============================================================

gut_clean_otu <- gut_clean_otu[
  rowSums(gut_clean_otu) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

gut_clean_tax <- tax_table(
  ps_gut
)

gut_clean_tax <- gut_clean_tax[
  rownames(gut_clean_otu),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

gut_clean_tree <- prune_taxa(
  rownames(gut_clean_otu),
  phy_tree(ps_gut)
)

gut_clean_metadata <- sample_data(
  ps_gut
)

gut_clean_metadata <- gut_clean_metadata[
  colnames(gut_clean_otu),
  ]

ps_gut_clean <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(
    gut_clean_otu,
    taxa_are_rows = TRUE
  ),
  sample_data(
    gut_clean_metadata
  ),
  tax_table(
    gut_clean_tax
  ),
  phy_tree(
    gut_clean_tree
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 26. FINAL CLEANUP
# ============================================================

ps_gut_clean <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps_gut_clean) > 0,
  ps_gut_clean
)

ps_gut_clean <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(ps_gut_clean) > 0,
  ps_gut_clean
)


# ============================================================
# 27. FINAL GUT DATASET SUMMARY
# ============================================================

cat("\n\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("FINAL microDecon-CLEANED GUT DATASET\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Samples:",
  nsamples(ps_gut_clean),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ASVs:",
  ntaxa(ps_gut_clean),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Total reads:",
  format(
    sum(sample_sums(ps_gut_clean)),
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Minimum reads/sample:",
  min(sample_sums(ps_gut_clean)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Maximum reads/sample:",
  max(sample_sums(ps_gut_clean)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Median reads/sample:",
  median(sample_sums(ps_gut_clean)),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Mean reads/sample:",
  mean(sample_sums(ps_gut_clean)),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 28. COMPARE BEFORE AND AFTER DECONTAMINATION
# ============================================================

reads_before <- sum(
  sample_sums(ps_gut)
)

reads_after <- sum(
  sample_sums(ps_gut_clean)
)

reads_removed_total <- (
  reads_before -
  reads_after
)

percent_removed <- (
  reads_removed_total /
  reads_before
) * 100


cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("DECONTAMINATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("========================================\n")

cat(
  "Reads before microDecon:",
  format(
    reads_before,
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Reads after microDecon:",
  format(
    reads_after,
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Reads removed:",
  format(
    reads_removed_total,
    big.mark = ","
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Percentage removed:",
  round(
    percent_removed,
    2
  ),
  "%\n"
)

cat(
  "ASVs before microDecon:",
  ntaxa(ps_gut),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ASVs after microDecon:",
  ntaxa(ps_gut_clean),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 29. SAVE FINAL OBJECTS
# ============================================================

saveRDS(
  ps_qc,
  file = "Results/ps_all_QC.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_gut,
  file = "Results/ps_gut_before_microDecon.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_gut_clean,
  file = "Results/ps_gut_microDecon_clean.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_water,
  file = "Results/ps_water.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_blanks,
  file = "Results/ps_extraction_blanks.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_standard,
  file = "Results/ps_bacterial_standard.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_filter,
  file = "Results/ps_filter_PBS.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  ps_field_blank,
  file = "Results/ps_field_blank.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  decon_result,
  file = "Results/microDecon_result.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  microdecon_table,
  file = "Results/microDecon_input.rds"
)


# ============================================================
# 30. SAVE CONTAMINATION SUMMARY TABLES
# ============================================================

write.csv(
  decon_result$reads.removed,
  "Results/microDecon_reads_removed.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  decon_result$difference.sum,
  "Results/microDecon_difference_sum.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  decon_result$difference.mean,
  "Results/microDecon_difference_mean.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  decon_result$OTUs.removed,
  "Results/microDecon_OTUs_removed.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# DONE
# ============================================================

cat("\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("PREPROCESSING COMPLETE\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
```

```{r}
# ASVs present in gut
gut_asvs <- taxa_names(ps_gut)[
  taxa_sums(ps_gut) > 0
]

# ASVs present in extraction blanks
blank_asvs <- taxa_names(ps_blanks)[
  taxa_sums(ps_blanks) > 0
]

# Compare
length(gut_asvs)
length(blank_asvs)

# ASVs shared between gut and blanks
shared_asvs <- intersect(
  gut_asvs,
  blank_asvs
)

length(shared_asvs)

# ASVs unique to gut
length(setdiff(gut_asvs, blank_asvs))

# ASVs unique to blanks
length(setdiff(blank_asvs, gut_asvs))

cat("Gut ASVs:", length(gut_asvs), "\n")
cat("Blank ASVs:", length(blank_asvs), "\n")
cat("Shared ASVs:", length(shared_asvs), "\n")
cat("Gut-only ASVs:", length(setdiff(gut_asvs, blank_asvs)), "\n")
cat("Blank-only ASVs:", length(setdiff(blank_asvs, gut_asvs)), "\n")
```



# Check Blank composition
```{r}
# ============================================================
# EXTRACTION BLANKS — TOP 10 PHYLA
# ============================================================

blank_phylum <- psmelt(ps_blanks) %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = ifelse(
      is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "",
      "Unclassified",
      Phylum
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Identify the 10 most abundant phyla across all blanks
top10_phyla <- blank_phylum %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

# Group everything else as "Other"
blank_phylum <- blank_phylum %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = ifelse(
      Phylum %in% top10_phyla,
      Phylum,
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    RelativeAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Order samples
blank_order <- sample_names(ps_blanks)

blank_phylum$Sample <- factor(
  blank_phylum$Sample,
  levels = blank_order
)

# Plot
ggplot(
  blank_phylum,
  aes(
    x = Sample,
    y = RelativeAbundance,
    fill = Phylum
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Extraction blanks: Phylum-level composition",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance",
    fill = "Phylum"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PBS + COMMUNITY STANDARD — GENUS LEVEL
# ============================================================
#
# Community standard theoretical composition:
# Listeria          12%
# Pseudomonas       12%
# Bacillus          12%
# Escherichia       12%
# Salmonella        12%
# Lactobacillus     12%
# Enterococcus      12%
# Staphylococcus    12%
# Saccharomyces      2%
# Cryptococcus       2%
#
# Everything else is grouped as "Other".
# ============================================================

ps_controls <- merge_phyloseq(
  ps_filter,
  ps_standard
)

control_genus <- psmelt(ps_controls) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(
      is.na(Genus) | Genus == "",
      "Unclassified",
      Genus
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Identify the 10 most abundant genera across PBS + standards
top10_genera <- control_genus %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Genus)

# Group everything else as "Other"
control_genus <- control_genus %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(
      Genus %in% top10_genera,
      Genus,
      "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    RelativeAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Order samples
control_order <- sample_names(ps_controls)

control_genus$Sample <- factor(
  control_genus$Sample,
  levels = control_order
)

# Order genera by overall abundance, with Other last
genus_order <- control_genus %>%
  filter(Genus != "Other") %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  pull(Genus)

control_genus$Genus <- factor(
  control_genus$Genus,
  levels = c(genus_order, "Other")
)

# Plot
ggplot(
  control_genus,
  aes(
    x = Sample,
    y = RelativeAbundance,
    fill = Genus
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PBS and community standards: Genus-level composition",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance",
    fill = "Genus"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )

# Should be
# Listeria          12%
# Pseudomonas       12%
# Bacillus          12%
# Escherichia       12%
# Salmonella        12%
# Lactobacillus     12%
# Enterococcus      12%
# Staphylococcus    12%
# Saccharomyces      2%
# Cryptococcus       2%

# ============================================================
# COMMUNITY STANDARD — OBSERVED VS EXPECTED
# ============================================================

expected <- c(
  Listeria = 12,
  Pseudomonas = 12,
  Bacillus = 12,
  `Escherichia-Shigella` = 12,
  Salmonella = 12,
  Limosilactobacillus = 12,
  Enterococcus = 12,
  Staphylococcus = 12,
  Saccharomyces = 2,
  Cryptococcus = 2
)

standard_actual <- psmelt(ps_standard) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(
      is.na(Genus) | Genus == "",
      "Unclassified",
      Genus
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = sum(Abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Observed = Abundance / sum(Abundance) * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(Genus %in% names(expected)) %>%
  mutate(
    Expected = expected[Genus],
    Difference = Observed - Expected,
    PercentDeviation = (Observed - Expected) / Expected * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Observed))

standard_actual
```
